description: Julia is a language for maths, data and general programming. It combines short code with fast number tools. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.
versionNote: Examples use Julia 1.9 or later and built-in tools.
whatYouWillLearn: Read an array item with Julia
learningObjectives: Apply an action to every item with Julia
Use a named key with Julia
